title: Paytm gets RBI's in-principle nod to revive wallet business through new subsidiary
summary: Paytm’s subsidiary PPSL has received the RBI’s in-principle approval to issue prepaid instruments such as wallets, but it must submit a system audit report within six months.
llm_summary: Paytm’s new subsidiary, Paytm Payments Services Ltd (PPSL), has secured an in‑principle nod from the Reserve Bank of India to launch prepaid products such as digital wallets. The approval comes with a condition: PPSL must file a comprehensive system‑audit
